name: Moe Zart
source:
Moe Zart is a rude and arrogant dog. He considers himself superior to others and isn't afraid to get into conflicts with those he deems lesser. 

[spoiler]Moe conspires with [url=/c143358]Lou[/url] to kill [url=/c143276]Flippy[/url] and [url=/c143357]Pete[/url], but their plan fails when [url=/c143279]Tom[/url] catches them in the act. Whether or not he lands the killing blow on Tom and is executed depends on the player's choices.[/spoiler]
